PRACTICE THE AIRLIFT. DELIVER THE GOOD. ✈️📦

Being ready to help starts before the call comes.

Pilots for Humanity is organizing Operation Takeoff Roll at Wisconsin’s La Crosse Regional Airport on November 20—a training exercise for volunteer pilots and ground crews preparing for future disaster-relief missions.

The cargo will be real donations. Pilots will bring supplies from their home communities, with goods destined for local organizations including the Hunger Task Force of La Crosse, WAFER Food Pantry and WINN.

Teams will practice aircraft arrivals, parking, unloading and tracking supplies. Civil Air Patrol cadets from the La Crosse Composite Squadron are expected to help handle and sort the cargo.

It’s a practical example of general aviation doing good: building the coordination needed for a future emergency while helping neighbors right now.

The exercise is scheduled for November 20, with November 21 as the weather backup. Here’s to the volunteers putting preparation—and compassion—into their flight plans. 💛
